integrity: The mathematical proof and exact rational-arithmetic checks were evaluated in a self-review; no independent audit or historical-priority certification.
scientific_limitations: Only full-dimensional Euclidean solid ellipsoids and independent volume-uniform points.
Population moments, not finite-sample statistical inference.
Semiaxes only up to ordering; no translation or orientation recovery.
A potential earlier finite-moment consequence of classical spherical-quadratic-form theory has not been excluded.
title: Sharp finite distance-moment tomography of solid Euclidean ellipsoids
